objective: Diagnosticar exclusivamente en READ_ONLY por que fallo sql_readonly_audit del Gate12J R1. No reemitir 12J funcional, no avanzar a 12K, no modificar SQL/codigo/RBAC/secrets. Auditar existencia y columnas fisicas de CavaSocios_Socios, Gobierno_Persona, Gobierno_PersonaVinculo y Cliente_Catalogo, y luego ejecutar solo consultas compatibles con las columnas realmente presentes.

queries.name: identity_guard
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS db_user,ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login;

queries.name: required_tables
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS table_name,o.object_id FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.type='U' AND o.name IN (N'CavaSocios_Socios',N'Gobierno_Persona',N'Gobierno_PersonaVinculo',N'Cliente_Catalogo') ORDER BY o.name;

queries.name: cava_socios_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS type_name,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') ORDER BY c.column_id;

queries.name: gobierno_persona_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS type_name,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona') ORDER BY c.column_id;

queries.name: gobierno_personavinculo_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS type_name,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo') ORDER BY c.column_id;

queries.name: cliente_catalogo_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS type_name,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Cliente_Catalogo') ORDER BY c.column_id;

queries.name: cava_socios_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_socios,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_persona,SUM(CASE WHEN PersonaID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_persona FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios;

queries.name: persona_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_personas FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona;

queries.name: persona_vinculo_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_vinculos FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo;

queries.name: cliente_population
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_clientes FROM dbo.Cliente_Catalogo;
